The table lists every atom of one conventional cell (cell parameters in the first line of the table) of 9-(phenylethynyl)anthracene (C22 H14, COD 7243051) as fractional coordinates. Use the kinematic structure factor F(hkl) = Σ_j Z_j exp[2πi(h x_j + k y_j + l z_j)] with atomic numbers as angle-independent weights (C = 6, H = 1). Exactly one of the four reflections below has |F| = 0. Which one?

选项：
A. (2 1 0)
B. (1 1 1)
C. (1 0 3)
D. (1 1 2)
